newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle Thursday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle Thursday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was moderate to active, with slaughter steers and heifers steady, USDA said.

Inquiry good, demand moderate. Sales confirmed on 25,400 slaughter steers and 25,000 slaughter heifers Thursday. Week to date 90,800 head confirmed including 20,200 head or about 22 percent of previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1300 lbs 64.00, couple pens Holsteins 1140-1170 lbs 56.50.

Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 990-1125 lbs 64.00, pen few light weights 1025 lbs 63.50. Dressed basis - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1050 lbs 102.50; few 950 lbs 102.00 with carcasses under 535 lbs 25.00 off; few mixed Commercial to Choice heifers with end heiferettes 1200 lbs 101.00.
Wk to date - 90,800 last week - 89,500 last year - 68,400
